description.value: Homesteader Health Foods is a locally owned natural grocery chain with its original location in Fort St. John, BC, open since 1989. The store carries certified organic produce, bulk grains, legumes and herbs, vitamins and supplements, and a range of natural personal care products. For a touring cyclist resupplying in Fort St. John, it offers one of the broader selections of organic and whole-food staples in the region, with three Registered Nutritional Consultant Practitioners on staff.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is an active health food grocery store at the OSM address (9920 97 Ave, Fort St. John) with a matching phone number. The site explicitly lists organic groceries, bulk foods, fruits, vegetables, breads, cereals, and legumes, confirming the basic groceries amenity. No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; those fields are left null. A name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Homesteaders Health' while the website consistently uses 'Homesteader Health Foods'.
